text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …So what's your bet? Is the card on the table higher or lower than five?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Doesn't take much effort to figure out the answer is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Nakayama, what fun are you getting yourself into this time?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there, princess. Don't tell me you're looking to jump in?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Why, yes. A bit of risk is the quickest route to building mental fortitude. Please let me play too!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You just have to guess if the next card will be higher or lower than this five card. So, which'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: There are fewer numbers lower than five, so the answer's pretty obvious.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sure about that, missy? It's a pretty risky choice.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm fine! If you don't take high risks, you won't get high returns.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pfft… Haha. You've got guts. All right, you two.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Care to play on till there's a clear winner?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The card on the table is revealed to be a four! As if by a miracle, all three of them have made the right choice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, a legend unfolds at lunchtime, marking the beginning of the Risk-Takers' Den!
